steps.title: Stock leaderboard — full universe at latest date
steps.narration: The stock leaderboard now shows the complete, correctly-sized universe at today's date. After a full snapshot rebuild, 544 stocks appear instead of the stale 122-member flat list that had been served at every date.
steps.point_out: Row count near top of table reads 544/544 — all filters set to 'All'. Each row shows leadership, entry, and risk scores alongside sector and setup labels.

steps.title: Honest empty universe at a pre-warm-up date
steps.narration: Step the date back to January 2021 and the leaderboard honestly shows zero stocks. No data is fabricated — the system admits names only once they have the required price history, so the early universe is genuinely empty.
steps.point_out: The table is completely empty with a message confirming no stocks qualified on that date. The row counter reads 0, not 122.

expect.text: No ranked stocks at this date

steps.title: Dynamic universe at a full-history date
steps.narration: Jump to February 2022 and the same leaderboard fills with 504 stocks — the genuine point-in-time universe for that date. The count slides with the date rather than staying fixed at an arbitrary number.
steps.point_out: Table shows approximately 504 rows. The very first row displays a leadership score and ticker — confirming real data, not a placeholder.

steps.title: NVDA leaderboard row — score snapshot
steps.narration: Back at the latest date, NVDA appears on the leaderboard with three canonical scores. These values come from the single rebuilt snapshot — the same store that powers both the list and the detail page.
steps.point_out: NVDA row is visible with Leadership, Entry, and Risk score columns populated. Note the exact score values — we will confirm they match the detail page next.

steps.title: NVDA detail page — scores match the leaderboard
steps.narration: Opening the NVDA detail page shows the identical leadership, entry, and risk scores seen on the leaderboard. Both views read from the same rebuilt snapshot, confirming a single source of truth.
steps.point_out: The scores shown under 'Leadership', 'Entry', and 'Risk' headings are numerically identical to the NVDA row on the list. The 'as of 2026-06-16' badge is visible alongside the setup status.

steps.title: Risk-Off date — zero Actionable stocks
steps.narration: On a bear-market date in June 2022 the regime reads Risk-Off and the leaderboard returns no Actionable stocks. The risk gate is working as intended — market conditions suppress all buy signals automatically.
steps.point_out: Market Regime badge shows 'Risk-off' with a low score. No rows carry an Actionable status — only watchlist-level entries remain.

steps.title: Dashboard — market regime breakdown
steps.narration: The dashboard at a Defensive-regime date shows the full market-phase panel with a score, regime label, and a component table. Breadth figures are labelled universe-relative, keeping the analysis honest about the dynamic universe size.
steps.point_out: The 'Market Regime' panel displays a numeric score, a regime label such as 'Defensive', and a row-by-row component breakdown. Breadth metrics carry the 'universe-relative' label.

steps.title: Backtest — no secondary date picker
steps.narration: The Backtest page uses the single global as-of switcher as its only date control. No page-local date input exists anywhere, so there is no way to accidentally introduce a second, conflicting date state.
steps.point_out: The Backtest page is fully rendered. Scanning the entire page surface reveals no date input fields beyond the global switcher — just the survivorship-bias label and the scan-date cards loaded from the snapshot store.
